designVerdict: NOT FITTED. Was C7, the TPS54360B COMP high-frequency pole, on the belief that it is C0G. It is X7R - LCSC's own parameters and the Walsin part code both say so, and 0402B151K is the X7R code. For a compensation pole the difference is real: +-15% over temperature against +-30 ppm/C. Replaced by C106998 (NP0, +-5%, 311k stock).
